title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Science - Environmental Science - Waste Management
subject: General Science

questions.q: A housing society has started segregating waste into two dustbins—a green bin for kitchen waste and a blue bin for plastics, metals, and glass. What is the main benefit of this practice?
options: It increases the amount of waste generated.
It reduces the bad odor of the garbage.
It speeds up the waste collection process.
It helps in separating non-biodegradable waste from biodegradable waste.
questions.explain: Source segregation using green and blue bins allows for separating biodegradable wet waste (kitchen waste) from dry, non-biodegradable, and recyclable waste (plastics, metals, glass), thus enabling efficient recycling and composting.
